rules.why: Coverage turns on the building construction date or mobile-home-space offering date, and November 19, 2021 is when the new ordinance took effect.
Coverage excludes housing produced in the last 15 years, so ordinary multifamily coverage depends on building age, and November 19, 2021 is the ordinance start date.
It broadly covers residential rental property citywide without a building-date coverage test, and April 2, 2026 is the ordinance effective date.
